facts: The tenth domestic Chinese championship final was held on 2024-06-17. Dang Yifei beat Lian Xiao as White by one quarter stone. Organizers were the Chinese Weiqi Association, Zhejiang sports administration and Quzhou government.

sources.title: 기왕전 (대한민국)
facts: Kiwang means 棋王戰, a Korean domestic tournament organized by Chosun Ilbo, beginning in 1974 and ending with its twentieth edition in 1996. The fifth edition ended in 1979, eighteenth in 1994, nineteenth in 1995 and twentieth in 1996.
It preceded the LG international tournament but is a separate domestic type in this catalog. A domestic twenty-fourth edition is impossible. Kiwang is neither Wangwi (王位戰) nor Giseong (棋聖戰).

sources.title: Wangwi
facts: Wangwi is a separate South Korean tournament sponsored by Chung-ang Il-po. It remains the existing 韩国王位战 type; no Kiwang candidate is merged into it.

sources.title: 원익배 십단전 tournament history
facts: The official event is Wonik Siptan, organized by Kyunghyang and Baduk TV, sponsored by Wonik. The table gives eight title decisions, from first in 2006 through eighth in 2013, with best-of-three finals.

Official champions establish that candidate third through eighth finals in 2008–2013 belong to this tournament. It is separate from Japanese Judan, Taiwan UMC ten-dan, Korean female ten-dan and Korean Chunwon.

sources.title: Siptan
facts: The Korean 十段戰 began in 2005, ran eight editions and ended in 2013. Editions span 2005–2006 through 2012–2013; thus a following-year final is expected, while DT 1900-01-01 is not a valid tournament date.
Siptan/Sibdan is the Korean ten-dan tournament; transliteration or similar title rank does not merge it with Japanese Judan or another country’s ten-dan event.
